caption_linkedin:
Black Friday is the one week a year when rooms that usually stay full go on sale.

The Innovators Den asked hotels, resorts, cruise lines and brands for their confirmed offers and published 23 of them in one edit. Three patterns stood out:

1. Credit plus discount beats a bigger percentage. Hyatt and Aruba Marriott both pair 25% off with $100 resort credit.
2. Boutique brands are discounting for the first time. Namron Hospitality is running its first-ever Black Friday offer.
3. Purpose sells. Four hotels on the list donate with every booking.
